app_fee.value: The Graduate College charges a USD 90 application fee, paid by credit card before the program deadline.
app_fee.quote: Once you have submitted your application, you will be required to pay a $90.00 application fee by credit card.

fee_waiver.value: International applicants cannot get a fee waiver unless they come under an exchange agreement with an approved waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: International applicants are not eligible for an application fee waiver unless coming under a valid exchange agreement that has an approved application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The Graduate College does not require the GRE, but individual programs may; check the program record.
gre_general.quote: The GRE and GMAT tests are not required for admission to the Graduate College, but they may be required for admission to your proposed program of study

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT minimum is 4.0 on the new 1-6 scale (79 on the old scale) for limited-status admission; full status needs 5.0 (103 old). Below full status you take the ESL Placement Test on arrival.
toefl_min.quote: Limited Status Admission Minimum | Full Status Admission Minimum | 4.0 (for scores dated after 1/20/2026) | 79 (for scores dated prior to 1/21/2026) | 5.0 (for scores dated after 1/20/2026) | 103 (for scores dated prior to 1/21/2026)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall for limited-status admission; 7.5 for full status.

english_waiver.value: Only degrees or two years of study/work in the US or an approved English-primary country exempt you; India is not on the list, so Indian applicants need a test score.
english_waiver.quote: Received a post-secondary degree from a U.S. institution (or an institution within an approved country) within five years of the proposed admission term. | Illinois Graduate Admissions recognizes the following countries as having English as the primary language: Australia, Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, Canada,

notes: Programs may set higher English scores. Teaching assistants need separate spoken-English proof; Duolingo does not satisfy the TA requirement.
